linkHelp.building: Opens that building. Use on the residence picture: buyers click a building to see its own pictures (or its apartments floor by floor).
linkHelp.floor: Opens that floor’s picture, e.g. a floor plan where each apartment is clickable.
linkHelp.unit: An apartment from your Inventory. The card shows its number, floor, m², bedrooms, price and live status; clicking opens its details. Use this for apartments you sell in this residence.
linkHelp.listing: A published BalkanEstate listing (e.g. a resale flat). The card shows the listing’s photo, price, m², floor and rooms; clicking opens the listing page. To show a listing on one of your apartments, link the region to the unit and attach the listing to that unit instead.
linkHelp.entrance: Marks a building entrance. It shows a label but does not open anything.

guide.title: How it works: residence picture, buildings, units and listings
guide.step1: Pick “Site plan (aerial)”, upload one picture of the whole residence and draw a region around each building → Links to: Building.
guide.step2: Pick a building, add one or more pictures of it (front, back…) and draw a region over each apartment → Links to: Unit.
guide.step3: Units are the apartments in your Inventory tab (number, floor, m², price, status). If an apartment is also advertised, attach its listing to the unit in Linked listings.
guide.step4: Save draft, then Publish. Buyers hover a region to see its card and click to open it.
guide.demo: Want an example? Run “npm run seed:developments” in the backend: it creates “East Gate Living (Demo)” with every kind of region.
